Package hadur.bench

Class MeleeReport

java.lang.Object
hadur.bench.MeleeReport
public final class MeleeReport extends Object
The melee bench's report, built from each battle's melee.csv (the engine's final scores), rounds.csv (MeleeHarvester) and hadur.log.

The headline numbers follow the MeleeRumble's pairwise scoring, so the plan's gates read straight off them:

  • APS: for each battle and each other non-sentry robot, Hadur's share of the pair's scores, 100 H / (H + X), averaged.
  • Survival: for each round, the share of the other robots Hadur outlived, (N - place) / (N - 1), averaged, as a percentage.
